source_fidelity.integrals: Both B and Bsin are the genuine inline Lebesgue integrals with the original complex phases; no abstract tail or amplitude bound premise.
source_fidelity.outside_set: Strict |v|>|u|/aStar; source factor c is absorbed into aStar=a_*/c exactly as frozen. Later actual Region3/5 scale inequalities remain obligations.
source_fidelity.conclusions: All four actual norm/|v|-weighted IntegrableOn assertions; tails of exponent31/30; exact sine factor min(y*|u|,1).
source_fidelity.boundary_and_degenerate_cases: Either sign of u and v; both theta endpoints; low |v|; u=0 and y=0. The low shifted-sine argument needs no division by y; when y=0 the w bound forces w=0.

proof_review.genuine_ibp32: Actual recursively differentiated quotients F_(n+1)=D_r(F_n/q) on the compact joint (s,theta,r) family. Global smoothness and support are proved at every order. Compactness yields a bound for F_32 independent of s/theta/v.
proof_review.phase_nonstationarity: q=s/(2*sqrt(r))-1 is smooth/nonzero on the compact outer box |s|,|theta|<=1/8, r in [1/16,4]; sqrt(r)>=1/4, hence -5/4<=q<=-3/4. |u*y/v|<=1/16 follows from the exact outside inequality and smallness.
proof_review.boundary_zero: Each F_n and F_n/q has tsupport within the fixed [1/16,4] in r. On the finite containing interval [-1,5] all boundary products vanish exactly, and compact support pays the whole-line library IBP product integrability requirements.
proof_review.frequency_signs: The recursion uses v rather than assuming v>0; taking norms gives |v|. Coarse sine splitting explicitly controls B(-u) and B(u).
proof_review.small_sine: True parameter derivative is the actual integral of a*sqrt(r)*cos(s*sqrt(r)); dominated differentiation uses |a*sqrt(r)|. Complex mean-value norm inequality and S(0)=0 give the |s| factor. Trig shift and |u*w|<=y*|u| retain it.
proof_review.measurability: Continuity of actual B/Bsin is proved by dominated parameter integration with compact amplitude majorant; norm and |v| products are continuous.
proof_review.tail_integration: Exact even real-power tail identity, then positive reciprocal-power domination; the first weight reduces power32 to31 and yields exponent30. No conditional probability or whole-u boundary assertion is used.

amplitude_family.interface_fully_read: Complete public amplitude-family statement: global smoothness, compact support, all derivatives j<=32 and a common M before parameters. Uses smoothness/support and j=0 here; the new joint recurrence pays its own genuine uniform F_32 bound.
